## What changed

Describe the requirement or test coverage added.

## Why

Explain the customer or product risk addressed.

## Review checklist

- [ ] Test IDs are unique
- [ ] Requirements are traceable
- [ ] Preconditions establish a known state
- [ ] Steps use specific, safe test data
- [ ] Expected results are observable
- [ ] Negative and boundary risks are considered
- [ ] Execution results do not claim unperformed testing
